reason: The 1.6.0 rebuild makes CloakBrowser, a stealth Chromium marketed to pass bot detection and shipped under a restrictive binary license, the default browser for logged-in platform channels, and copies site cookies from a connected Chrome on first use. The installed SKILL.md is also now a template with unrendered {{VERSION}} and {{CHANNEL_TABLE}} placeholders, so the reviewed pin stays until the anti-detection default is removed or explicitly accepted.
